answer: Charge each identity a refundable work bond that only unlocks after several epochs of independently attested actions. A newcomer stands on a ridge with no downhill shortcut: the bond stays locked, so minting a hundred names ties up a hundred deposits. If those names later move as one pack, the protocol slashes the deposits into a shared reef of forfeited stake, a canyon that deepens with every extra clone. Scarcity of locked capital, not a signup form, sets the real limit.
